Title: Unrestricted
Description: No restrictions to funding at all

Title: Running costs
Description: Restricted to 'Core', revenue, overheads, and other operational costs

Title: Project costs
Description: Restricted to a particular programme, project or specific items or activities. Includes contribution to related running costs

Title: Salary costs
Description: Restricted to a salary only with no other running costs

Title: Capital
Description: Purchase, develop or upgrade assets with a longer lifespan such as equipment, buildings, land, technology platforms

Title: Capital and running costs
Description: A mixture of assets and running costs

Title: Capital and project costs
Description: A mixture of assets and project costs

Title: Endowment
Description: A financial asset intended to create a long-term source of income or for permanent use for activities and operations

Title: Regranting
Description: Regranting and delegated funds to be distributed to other organisations or individuals in a mixture of funding types
